```{r Initialisation, echo = T, include = T}
library(ggplot2)
library(terra)
library(here)

setwd(here::here())

source("Code/config.R")
source("Code/UrbanES_Recreationfunctions.R")


####### LOAD DATA #######
# Study area
communes_perimeter = vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Communes/communes_perimeter.shp"))
communes_perimeter_buff = buffer(communes_perimeter, 500)

#CoSIA Land Use, 10m resolution
colu = rast(file.path(path_data_raw, "Land_use/Cosia/cosia_10m.tif"))
names(colu) = c("lu_num")
colu = terra::mask(colu, communes_perimeter_buff)
seg_colu = segregate(colu, classes = NULL, keep = T, other = NA) # A raster for which each layer is a land use

# The urban areas, defined from the Global Human Settlement database
rast_grid = rasterize(communes_perimeter_buff, seg_colu)

urban_fabric = rast(file.path(path_data_raw, "GlobalHumanSettlement/GHS_2154.tif"))
urban_fabric[urban_fabric<20] = NA # select the categories we want
urban_fabric[!is.na(urban_fabric)] = 1 # Put all the values to 1
urban_fabric = as.polygons(urban_fabric, aggregate = T)

# Need to also keep the INSEE squares that are on the border
geoportail = vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "INSEE/200m_selection_urb.shp"))
urban_fabric = geoportail[is.related(geoportail, urban_fabric, "intersects")]
urban_fabric_buff = buffer(urban_fabric, 1000)
city_buff = rasterize(urban_fabric_buff, rast_grid, field = "i_est_200", background = NA) # Polygonized and rasterized for a proper resolution
city_buff[!is.na(city_buff)] = 1

# Parks and green spaces, built on QGIS from OpenStreetMap
green_spaces = vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/osm_parks.shp"))

rast_parks = rasterize(green_spaces, rast_grid, field = "use_type", background = NA, fun = max)

# Selection of the parks and green areas in a buffer around urban areas. 
rast_parks = terra::mask(rast_parks, urban_fabric_buff)

# Patching to measure park size (if there is only a short distance between two parks, count as 1 park)
buffed_parks = buffer(rast_parks, 10, background = NA) # Buffer around rast_parks
buffed_patches = patches(buffed_parks, 8, allowGaps = F) # Identify patches 
park_patch = terra::mask(buffed_patches, rast_parks) # Removing buffers

npatches = max(values(park_patch), na.rm = TRUE) # number of parks

# Amenities
fountains =   vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/osm_fountains.shp")) # point layers for the fountains
playgrounds = vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/osm_playgrounds.shp")) # Playgrounds
fitness =    vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/osm_fitness.shp")) # Open air fitness areas
drink_wat =   vect(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/osm_drinking_water.shp")) # Drinking water points

am_int = list(fitness,playgrounds,drink_wat) # List of point layers or the interesting amenities

# Roads
all_roads = rast(file.path(path_data_raw, "Amenities/road_noise.tif")) # Raster layer of 3 "road levels", built from OpenStreetMap on QGIS


#Removing the temporary elements
rm(urban_fabric, drink_wat, fitness, playgrounds)

####### RUN MODELS #######

### Overall park quality assessment
## Visual quality
visu = visual_quality_distance(slu = seg_colu, parks = park_patch,
               luH = c("13", "15"), luT = c("8", "10"), luW = c("4", "6"), ftn = fountains,
               grid = rast_grid )

terra::writeRaster(visu, file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "attractiveness.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

## Recreation opportunities
opp = recre_opp_distance(parks = park_patch, npatches = npatches, am_int = am_int, grid = rast_grid)
terra::writeRaster(opp,  file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "opportunities.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc() 

## Pollution
poll = pollut(parks = park_patch, slu = seg_colu, luna = c("1", "8", "10"), luB = "1",
           lvls = c(60, 80, 90), matw = data.frame(lu = c(1, 8, 10), weight = c(50,10,10)),
           lvl_road = all_roads)

terra::writeRaster(poll,  file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "pollution.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

all = serv_tot(attractiveness = visu, opportunities = opp, pollutions = poll)
terra::writeRaster(all,  file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "all_serv_parks.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
terra::writeRaster(all[[4]],  file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "parks_quality.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)

gc()

### Select only target area
e = ext(890000, 940000, 6432000, 6482000)
parks_quality= all[[4]]
parks_quality = crop(parks_quality, e)

# Measure overall service based on decay distance
recre_decay = qual_decay(parks_quality, radius_in_pixels = 100, decay_half_dist = 300)
recre_decay[is.na(recre_decay)] = 0
terra::writeRaster(recre_decay,  file.path(path_intermdediate_results, "recre_decay_300_whole_region.tif"), datatype = "FLT8S", overwrite = TRUE)
```
